from scipy.optimize import least_squares
m=A<0.7
tt=t[m]; yy=dA_dt[m]
forms={
 'a-b t^p': (lambda p: p[0]-p[1]*tt**p[2], 3),
 'a exp(-b t^p)': (lambda p: p[0]*np.exp(-p[1]*tt**p[2]), 3),
 'a/(1+b t^p)': (lambda p: p[0]/(1+p[1]*tt**p[2]), 3),
 'a exp(-b t)+c': (lambda p: p[0]*np.exp(-p[1]*tt)+p[2], 3),
 'a - b t + c t^2': (lambda p: p[0]-p[1]*tt+p[2]*tt**2, 3),
 'a exp(-b t)/(1+c t)': (lambda p: p[0]*np.exp(-p[1]*tt)/(1+p[2]*tt), 3),
 'a/(1+b t)^p': (lambda p: p[0]/(1+p[1]*tt)**p[2], 3),
 'a - b*t - c*sin?': (lambda p: p[0]-p[1]*tt-p[2]*tt**3, 3),
}
rng=np.random.default_rng(1)
for name,(f,k) in forms.items():
    best=None
    for s in range(60):
        p0=rng.uniform(0.2,3,size=k)
        try:
            sol=least_squares(lambda p: f(p)-yy, p0)
            v=np.mean(sol.fun**2)/np.var(yy)
            if np.isfinite(v) and (best is None or v<best[0]): best=(v,sol.x)
        except Exception: pass
    print(name, best[0], np.round(best[1],4))
